data.exact_reserve_text: During the year the syndicate entered into a significant transaction with a third party organisation, whereby, in return for a reinsurance premium, the syndicate benefits from 100% reinsurance of certain long tail outstanding claims on 2014 and prior underwriting years. This policy removes reserve uncertainty applicable to the reinsured claims, and is due to be followed by legal transfer of the underlying claims to the reinsurer.

data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2016 were GBP 1,861.147m. The report does not disclose a quantified gross prior-year reserve movement; the available claims development triangle is presented on a net basis and shows no material net prior-year development, and the syndicate reports a material reinsurance transaction providing 100% cover for certain long-tail 2014-and-prior claims which removes reserve uncertainty. The underwriting result was adversely affected by the change in the Ogden discount rate, primarily on the casualty treaty account, but this was offset in part by the reinsurance transfer of specified 2014-and-prior reserves.
raw_causal_phrases: anticipated impact of the recent announcement from the Ministry of Justice, reducing the statutory discount rate applied to certain UK personal injury claims (referred to as Ogden tables) to -0.75%. This impact primarily arose from sub-Syndicate 566's casualty treaty account.

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit GROSS prior-year movement (movement in prior year's provision) is disclosed in the notes. A gross claims development triangle was not available; only a NET claims development table was present and shows effectively zero net prior-year development. Therefore prior_year_development_gbp_m is reported as 0.0 based on the net triangle fallback (source 6). The report explicitly describes a 100% reinsurance transaction covering certain 2014-and-prior long-tail claims and an adverse impact from the Ogden discount rate change; these narrative items were used to identify causes and affected years. Use caution: prior-year movement is NET-based fallback rather than a reported GROSS re-estimate.
